subject.title: Workspaces: add scoped Teams control hub

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally expand from one trusted operator boundary per Gateway to a supported gateway-local Teams boundary and ship `api.teams` as a public plugin contract?
rationale: Source review cannot determine whether the existing one-user trust model is being deliberately replaced, supplemented only for same-trust teams, or retained with this capability living outside core; that choice controls the acceptable threat model, documentation and API permanence.

options.title: Approve a bounded Teams mode
options.body: Define the supported tenant threat model and non-goals, review the authorization foundation separately, update security guidance and require live isolation and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to same-trust collaboration
options.body: Keep grouping, presence and owner-controlled sharing as collaboration ergonomics without claiming adversarial isolation or exposing a permanent multi-tenant plugin API.

options.title: Keep the one-user model
options.body: Do not merge the in-core identity boundary and route multi-user isolation to separate gateways or an external owner/plugin solution.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded Teams mode
recommendation.body: Define the supported tenant threat model and non-goals, review the authorization foundation separately, update security guidance and require live isolation and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision changes repository-wide product scope, public security guidance and long-lived plugin contracts rather than only the Workspaces implementation.
